title: [Bug] CLI hangs mid-conversation requiring session restart
body:
**Bug Description**
some reason since yesterday, randomly mid way, u send a message nothing happens, u send another message nothing happens. then u have to completely stop the chat / session.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 2.0.60
- Feedback ID: 5c17921e-60d7-4dfc-b466-39b78bc7c9b1
